title: Message/set accepts deletedForAll on non-self messages, now purges their content
description: crate-jmap-chat-server/src/message.rs:742-748. The update path never checks that the target Message has senderId "self" before it honors deletedForAll:true. Spec draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00 §Deleting a Message line 1160: 'Servers MUST reject deletedForAll: true for messages where senderId is not "self"'. The missing check predates this change, but commit ec422bce makes the result worse: a client that patches {deletedForAll:true} on a message from another sender now gets an irreversible purge (body "", attachments [], editHistory nulled) instead of a rejected update. Fix: prefetch the message (the reactions path at ~line 883 already does this) and return forbidden when sender_id != SenderId::Owner. Run this before any augmentation.
